_comment: The Races screen (SCREEN_RACE, 6), work order 175 C. Everything it draws is placed at the HD image of its native rectangle (racesgeom, through core/nativeview), so this file carries no geometry: only the markings, one per thing HD does that the original does not, or leaves out, or cannot do yet. Each is also stated in the module that performs it and held by the smoke group (dev:tools/smoke_suite/090e_races_the_races_screen.py).

marks.hd_state: BUILT, NOT ACCEPTED. The live part of work order 175 C is parked (dev:doc/briefs/175-parked-for-data.md).
marks.omission_outer_frame: OMISSION — RACES.LBX 0, the background with the panels, bars, sliders and buttons painted in, is not drawn; decision 71's HUD style draws them in code.
marks.deviation_hud_parts: DEVIATION — the slider, the mission row, the five buttons and the striped fields are HUD blocks at the original's rectangles, not RACES.LBX 2, 6-30, 60 and 0's painted fields; the relation bar is RACES.LBX 3 itself since work order 223.
marks.deviation_button_words: DEVIATION — RETURN, AUDIENCE, REPORT, DECLARE WAR, IGNORE, ESPIONAGE / SABOTAGE / HIDE, the title and BONUSES are baked into the original's art; HD writes them in OrionLayer's words.
marks.deviation_hd_font: DEVIATION — the bitmap fonts become the HD font at the native line height, shrunk to the original's width where they would overflow.
marks.hd_extension_sprite_scale: HD EXTENSION — portraits and spy icons at an integer magnification, centred on their native cell (decision 28).
marks.transcription_spy_move: TRANSCRIPTION, sent as one command — a click on a spy group picks the icon under the pointer and every icon right of it (Draw_Icon_Group_Cursor_, racescrn.cpp:600-635), a click on another group drops them there, no group above 63 (Move_Spy_Group_From_Mouse_, :390-408); a mission button sets that race's mission (:441-443). Each change goes as open fix 64's MSG_SET_SPIES, the whole list at once, which the engine writes into s_player.spies at once (work order 197; racesspies).
marks.deviation_spy_drop_rest: DEVIATION — what does not fit a group at the drop stays in the group it came from; the original keeps it in hand for another drop. HD keeps no hand across a command, and the hand is drawn as its number beside the pointer, not as the original's pointer icon.
marks.hd_state_armed_action: HD STATE — which action WHO mode has armed is a local of Race_Screen_; HD lights the button it sent itself and says nothing when the game armed one on its own (a hotkey in the fallback).
marks.omission_anomaly_leaders: OMISSION — the spy / agent bonus counts every spy-master and telepath leader; the original skips one at a space anomaly (Leader_At_Anomaly_, colcalc.cpp:1206), whose event table is not on the wire.
marks.hd_extension_hd_leaders: HD EXTENSION — a race slot's portrait cell shows Data's painting of that race's leader from the player's mod folder (files/screens/races/assets/leaders/<nn>_<name>.png, work order 315 B; racesleaders); a race without one, or the mod folder off, shows the original's RACES.LBX 32 + race as before.
marks.deviation_leader_cover: DEVIATION — the painting fills the cell, which the panel map draws at 1.16-1.17 : 1 where the original's drawing is 76 x 88 and enlarged by whole pixels: one rule for every race, scaled to cover the cell and cut centred across, from the top (racesleaders.window).
marks.hd_extension_who_lit: HD EXTENSION — in WHO mode the panel of the race under the pointer gets the popup's lit edge as well as the original's box round the portrait: HD cannot change the pointer to the original's 'who' cursor (RACES.LBX 5 / 61-63), so the panel says it instead.
marks.transcription_hover: TRANSCRIPTION, drawn by HD alone — the relation word over the bar under the pointer and, in WHO mode, the box round the race under it (racescrn.cpp:549-566). The API has no mouse motion; HD resolves the pointer itself and sends nothing.
marks.hd_extension_name_band: HD EXTENSION — the race's name, IGNORED and the relation word stand on a band of the HUD's glass (the box fill's panel colour at the glass's measured opacity, made denser until the word keeps 4.5 : 1 on it), under every portrait cell: the original prints them in an outlined font (Set_Font_Style_Outline, outline colour 177; racescrn.cpp:140-146, :563-572, :794; fonts.cpp:554-584, :812-815) that the HD font does not draw (work order 316 C; racesband).
marks.omission_their_spies: OMISSION — the original prints that race's spies in the player's empire over its portrait when there are any (BILL::Get_Their_Spy_Number, ROW_RACE_SPIES, racescrn.cpp:548-557); HD does not draw the number (found unlabelled by work order 316 C).
